intent: Form field that opens a month grid to pick one date.
useWhen: A date in a form or filter
Need a typed-looking field whose overlay is a month grid
doNotUseWhen: A schedule of events — use Calendar
A range of dates, with or without presets — use DateRangePicker (mode range is deprecated)

mode.note: single is one YYYY-MM-DD. range ({ start, end? }) is deprecated: it still works, with a warning in development. Use DateRangePicker, with presets={[]} for the month grid only.

value.note: controlled. string when single; { start, end? } when range. YYYY-MM-DD.

defaultValue.note: uncontrolled. string when single; { start, end? } when range.

onValueChange.note: (date: string) => void when single; (range: { start, end?: string }) => void when range

size.note: Trigger height sm 32, md 36, lg 40, like Input. The overlay month grid is sm when size is sm, else md.

placeholder.note: Defaults to Pick a date, or Pick dates when mode is range

minDate.note: Passed to the overlay month grid

maxDate.note: Passed to the overlay month grid

weekStart.note: First day of the week: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday. Moves the weekday row and Home/End.

isDateDisabled.note: (date: string) => boolean. Turns single days off, like holidays or weekends. Those days, and days outside minDate/maxDate, are struck through and named unavailable.

name.note: Hidden input for forms. Range submits start/end, like 2026-08-10/2026-08-18

describedBy.note: Field wires hint and error ids onto the trigger

requirements: error shows the danger border and Field's error text via aria-describedby; no aria-invalid on the trigger button (button does not support it)
Trigger is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, aria-controls
Overlay is role=dialog aria-modal labelled Choose date (or Choose dates in range) and contains DatePicker’s own month grid
Overlay header is the shared overlay header: CalendarDays icon and the picked date (or the placeholder) as the eyebrow, the Choose date title, and a Close button named by the close label
Opening focuses the picked day (else today), not Close. Arrows move by day and week, Home and End to the week's first and last day (weekStart), Page Up and Page Down by month
Today has a short bar under the number and is named today. Unavailable days are struck through, not only faded, and named unavailable
Range: first click sets start, second click sets end and closes. Escape discards an in-progress range

Tab stays in the overlay; Escape, Close and pointer down outside close and return focus to the trigger. Escape closes only the newest open overlay (the shared Escape stack), not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog

Month-grid overlay is at least as wide as the trigger and anchors to its end, growing toward the start edge when the trigger is narrower than the grid, so it fits in drawers without horizontal scroll. When that would cross the window's start edge it anchors to the trigger's start instead
Must have associated label via Field or a visible label pointing at id
error described by Field via describedBy
built-in labels (previousMonth, nextMonth, chooseDate, chooseDates, close) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not wrap DatePicker in Popover. The field owns its overlay. Do not invent a local calendar, DatePickerDialog, PeriodPicker, DualCalendar, or native input type=date
Named presets such as This month or Last 30 days — use DateRangePicker
Do not use two DatePickers for start and end, and do not use mode=range for new work (deprecated) — use DateRangePicker
Do not use the event Calendar as a date field
Do not add built-in label, hint, error text, help, or hideLabel — wrap with Field
Do not add time or Density, and no size past lg
snippet:
<Field label="Start date" htmlFor="start-date"><DatePicker id="start-date" value={date} onValueChange={setDate} /></Field>
<Field label="Due date" htmlFor="due"><DatePicker id="due" size="lg" weekStart={1} minDate="2026-11-24" isDateDisabled={isHoliday} /></Field>
